privacy.intro: This page explains how this site (plankbevelen.cn) collects, uses, and retains visit information.

collect.title: What We Collect
collect.body: This site records access logs, including: IP address, User-Agent (browser and device information), visit path, and visit time. This information is used solely for visit statistics (such as page views and visitor counts) and security troubleshooting.

usage.title: How We Use and Retain It
usage.body: Access logs are used only for site statistics and security protection. They are not used to identify individuals and are never sold or shared with third parties. Logs are automatically purged after a retention period (180 days by default).
